about: What each commit of this hour changed: its message beyond the subject, its session (the Claude-Session trailer), and its files with lines added and removed (git numstat; at most 40 files a commit). Written by tools/agents-commits.mjs. The list of commits: data/agents/commits.json.

b5b3dd7fb5b200cdfb7bfd4a7e652baec97b6181.body:
The retry the conductor applied (9ed312b, live from run 418) has not
fired yet. tools/ci-read.mjs names the second deploy step, leaves out
skipped steps, and marks a run the retry saved (deploy_retried; the list
is pipeline.deploy_retries in data/ci/index.json). The applied patch is
removed from ci/patches/.

fe2c133398bbb358d348e61d0d023c95b942a84d.body:
At the conductor's word (03:33): this session carries the largest context
of all, so the row goes to a fresh session. HANDOVER.md says what the row
owns, how the builder, the ontology and its allow-list for public posts
work, the pages and their pinned engines, the joins (entities, studio,
media; meteorology/ and sources/ not joined yet), what is unfinished in
order, and the wake. This session pushes nothing after this commit.

561cdeab3f161ac349051ca48b6666b02415f79d.body:
Same links on every page the build still links (703 pages compared byte for
byte with the previous linker's output). Left to app/lens/lens.js:
research/weather-sites/sites/, library/pack/, models/models/, evidence capture
pages, generated sources/<id>/ pages (board/items/ already).

31a5b210c942d32568ba974eb7b610941d05cfa3.body:
Runs 343 and 344 failed at deploy-pages with "No artifacts named
github-pages were found", as 54, 55 and 205 did: five of six failures.
ci/patches/deploy-retry.patch tries the deploy once more after 8 s (a
hypothesis; it can only be tested on the runner). tools/ci-read.mjs
stopped when the 02:00 hour of commits passed 256 KB: an hour now splits
by ten minutes (file names come from data/ci/index.json, as before).
The pipeline page shows the gate's budget as validate.mjs states it
(8 s since 95c0757). The signing patch rebuilt at f42d48a.

b0510c90c48f74e1543ba04208951b368774f947.body:
What it cost: about a dollar of third-party model calls against a cap of 20, a provider account that ran out five minutes
after the cap was raised, and sessions counted in tokens with no price, nearly all of them cache reads. The picture is
recounted from accounts/ledger/ on every build. Correction: piece 1 said two of Dinis's directions had no recording
commit; incident.reporter@'s arc trace found them (ce7d8f3, 5b880fb).

c067b3b17241ef7372da8aedfadb32bb102d112b.body:
Written from incident.reporter@'s small, medium and large traces. Each statement rests on a step (with the step's own
commit and first served version); the two steps the traces mark "no evidence" are said to be so. tools/journal-build.mjs
draws a trace as lanes (one per actor, a mark per step) and its table from reporter/traces/<id>.json at build time.

2d7320a23cb182bce4a1ac95b7e786bf57d9889e.body:
Only Dinis instructs, so a queue forms. The piece reads it from the board's cards (the board's own test for "waiting on
Dinis"), names the answers that came inside his directions (21:10, 02:10, 02:50), and the three things agents did while
waiting: took the cautious default and said so, worked by hand inside the rules, or stopped.

19f874b9fefbf99204c7172c8107d0caee18e037.body: app/site.css, design/HANDOVER.md, design/round-42.md, design/README.md, agents/designer/status.json, accounts/ledger/designer.jsonl (this wake's token line).

d762cf8f8106eeed87895b40fe8b0f38adb185b7.body:
The first piece was live with the wrong figure from v0.1.350 for a few minutes. The recounted table now uses the
board's own test (waiting_on === 'Dinis', not done or answered).

4b5a93ac6074fed9ee38156769940ef035678006.body:
reporter/traces/: one JSON per workflow in WS-212's step shape (sc-trace/1): 82 steps, each with its evidence
(BRIEF.md section, commit, the version that served it, file, live address) or marked no evidence (3). Hand-offs by
message are evidenced only by a For: trailer or a status line, and say so. traces/index.json carries every
five-line summary: read it first. tools/reporter-fill.mjs fills commit steps from git and data/ci/runs/ and checks
them; tools/reporter-numbers.mjs writes numbers.json from data/ci/ and board/items/ (nothing counted by hand).

855ac6695b954a898229a78918d5772f19257805.body:
Nothing is reviewed before it is published here, so each mistake was public first. The piece follows each to its
correcting commit and to the rule or tool it produced (or says none did: times written ahead of the clock, by five agents).
tools/journal-build.mjs gains a picture kind (commit-dots), drawn from the run data like the others.

f24a773588d231b4d7de5bb8dac6a3782fd2c38c.body:
research/perplexity/: three runs on the team's open questions (the bridges'
and tunnels' primary notice; Madeira's civil protection; Web Summit's
Wednesday talks, PITCH and tickets), asked in Portuguese and English
through tools/llm.mjs. 19 statements in our own words, each marked after
opening the address the engine cited: 7 confirmed at a primary source,
8 press only, 4 unsupported, 0 wrong; 10 times the engine said it found
no page. 90 addresses returned, 28 a primary body's. Spent 0.033 US
dollars; six calls to the Pro variants refused by OpenRouter (the key's
credit), at no cost.

Leads (research/perplexity/leads.json), each read by this desk at the
body's own address, for the conductor
